items.effect: approximated: flattened, the placeholder keeps the position and size it inherits as its own
items.label: placeholder(s) that take their position from the layout (flattened on import)

items.effect: approximated: the paths (lines, curves, arcs, several paths, fill modes) are kept as written; guide formulas are not evaluated, so a path that needs them keeps the shape's frame, fill and text but not its outline
items.label: shape(s) with custom geometry

items.effect: approximated: a preset outside the library is kept under its name and drawn approximately; custom geometry keeps its path unless it needs guide formulas
items.label: shape(s) with a geometry the editor lacks (custom geometry, or a preset outside its library; those are kept under their name and drawn approximately)
